title: JourneyChapter
description: data/running/owner/journey/chapters/<chapter-id>/chapter.yaml: one approved chapter of the journey story (specs/003-journey-story/data-model.md §3). Only approved text may enter this file (FR-032, FR-036). Its $defs line, paragraph and paragraphs are shared by the other journey files; each file carries its own approved block.

id.description: A slug. Equals the folder name. Set once, from the name, and never changed (FR-051).

name.description: Required plain text, one line. The chapter's heading.

when.description: Required. YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, or <start>/<end> with each end a month or a day. Start before end and not after today are checked by validate-data.
when.x-error: is not a day, a month or a period (expected YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, or start/end such as 2001-03/2001-09)

order.description: Optional integer. Required, and distinct, when two chapters share the same start (research.md R6).

prose.description: Required. Plain text in paragraphs separated by blank lines, with only the inline markup of data-model.md §5 ({{figure-id}} placeholders and [text](/path/) links).
prose.x-error: must be the chapter's text, not empty

takeaway.description: Required. Plain text, one paragraph, at most 400 characters (FR-004). No markup.
takeaway.x-error: must be one paragraph of at most 400 characters

figures.description: Optional, at most two (FR-010). Each is used by exactly one placeholder in prose.
figures.x-error: has more than two figures (a chapter carries at most two)

photos.x-error: has more than three photos (a chapter carries at most three)

approved.description: The owner's approval, written by scripts/approve-story.ts --journey after their explicit yes. sha256 covers the file's hashed fields (data-model.md §2).
approved.x-error: needs the owner's approval before it can be published

date.description: The date the owner approved the file. Not in the future.

sha256.description: 64 lower-case hexadecimal characters: the sha256 of the canonical JSON of the hashed fields. A mismatch means the file changed after approval.
sha256.x-error: is not a sha256 (64 lower-case hexadecimal characters)

line.description: Plain text on one line, with no leading or trailing spaces.
line.x-error: must be one line of text, not empty and not starting or ending with spaces

paragraph.description: Plain text, one paragraph: no blank line inside it.
paragraph.x-error: must be one paragraph of text, not empty and with no blank line

paragraphs.description: Plain text in paragraphs separated by blank lines. Its own rule, because defs text refuses the trailing line break of a | block.

dayOrMonth.x-error: is not a day or a month (expected YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM)

figure.title: JourneyFigure
figure.description: A figure placed in the prose by its {{id}} placeholder (research.md R5).

id.description: A slug, unique in the chapter. The placeholder's name.

category.description: One of the approved categories (research.md R5). Anything else needs a schema change, which records the owner's approval (FR-013). calories: approved by the owner on 2026-11-03.
category.x-error: is not an approved figure category (a new one needs a schema change, which records the owner's approval)

label.description: What it measures, plain text. Shown on a set-apart figure.

as_of.description: A day or a month, not in the future. Shown on a set-apart figure.

text.description: The figure exactly as approved. Matches its category's pattern (FR-077, data-model.md §3).

source.description: stored (taken from the site's data) or owner (FR-012).

ref.description: Required with source: stored: { run: <run-id> }, { health: { metric, date } }, { manual: { kind, as_of } } or { race: <slug> }. Not allowed with source: owner.
ref.x-error: is not a record reference (expected { run: <run-id> }, { health: { metric, date } }, { manual: { kind, as_of } } or { race: <slug> })

garmin.description: Optional: a Garmin device model (garminDevice from defs), Garmin alone, or derived.
garmin.x-error: must be a Garmin device model (e.g. Venu X1), Garmin, or derived

ref.x-error: is not allowed with source: owner (only a stored figure names its record)

text.x-error: must be a number with kg (e.g. 12.3 kg)
must be a number with bpm (e.g. 12 bpm)
must be a number with ms (e.g. 12 ms)
must be a clock time, m:ss or h:mm:ss (e.g. 1:23:45)
must be a number with km (e.g. 12.3 km)
must be a number with km (e.g. 1,234 km) or a duration h:mm
must be plain words with no digit
must be a comma-grouped number, or <n> to <n>, followed by calories (e.g. 1,234 calories)

garmin.x-error: must be Garmin: daily calories burned are a Garmin estimate

source.x-error: must be owner: this category isn't in the stored data

ref.x-error: must be a health reference ({ health: { metric, date } }) for this category
must be a manual-metrics reference ({ manual: { kind, as_of } }) for this category
must be a run reference ({ run: <run-id> }) for this category
must be a run or race reference ({ run: <run-id> } or { race: <slug> }) for this category

photo.title: JourneyPhoto
photo.description: A photo in the chapter's folder (data-model.md §4). Its bytes are in the chapter's approval hash.

file.description: A file in the chapter's folder.
file.x-error: is not a photo file name (letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', ending .jpg, .webp or .avif)

description.description: Required plain text: the alt text (FR-063).

caption.description: Required plain text, shown under the photo (FR-063).
